HOW LINGOREP WORKS

Learn from the English you speak daily

No separate lesson to schedule. Speak, review your feedback, practice, and use what you learned next time.

Record and review

Use the Chrome extension during a conversation, or record yourself speaking. Afterward, review your mistakes and clearer ways to phrase what you said.

Practice what matters

LingoRep looks across your five most recent conversations and creates short exercises for the patterns that matter most.

Repeat and improve

Use what you practiced in your next conversation. Then review the new feedback and keep working on what comes back.

Fix your English mistakes

See what you said, what needs fixing, and the corrected version. LingoRep checks grammar, word choice, word order, and usage.

Find a better way to say it

Word choices and sentence patterns from your first language can sound awkward or unclear in English. LingoRep shows another way to express the same idea.

Practice what you said. Improve what you say next.

LingoRep reviews your five most recent conversations and picks the mistakes and phrases worth working on. Short exercises help you use the corrections and better wording in your next conversation.

LingoRep records only your microphone

The extension does not capture meeting audio or anyone else's voice. LingoRep stores your transcript and language feedback in your account, but it does not store the raw audio file. Privacy details→

You can analyze up to 20 minutes each month. Free includes feedback on mistakes and awkward phrases, a speaking evaluation, and practice based on your recordings. You need an account. No card is required.

The main difference is time: 20 minutes per month on Free and 15 hours on Pro. Pro also includes more detailed feedback, practice that revisits earlier problems, and a weekly email summary.

LingoRep checks grammar, word choice, word order, and usage in the English you speak into your microphone. It also points out phrases that are understandable but could be clearer.

LingoRep records only your microphone. It does not record the meeting audio or anyone else in the call.

LingoRep stores your transcript and language feedback in your account. It does not store the raw audio file.

Use the Chrome extension during browser-based work meetings, sales calls, interviews, tutor sessions, language exchanges, or independent speaking practice.
